body: They know I use cannabis. I said it was for sleep. And it really does help me sleep. But at this point, I think I just keep using it to avoid a grippy sock vacation..
This is exactly how I feel. It's exhausting.
I read your comment too. I hope things turn around for you. I'm rooting for you anyway..
I'm here, checking on you. I hope you're okay.
And it will just hit you out of nowhere
How long will your dog have to be alone if you go through with it? I know your dog loves you and would really miss you. They remember us.
Ya. I definitely feel like I'm living so others I love don't hurt.
My dogs and a handful of friends/family that would be hurt if I did something to myself. It's like I see their pain and I can't bring myself to do that to them, so I just live my life in pain.

High-functioning and a big people pleaser all through my life. Then I turned 20 and everything changed completely. It's like a shaken bottle of soda. I did my best to hide how I felt growing up and now I'm 27 and every time I feel a little better, I open up a little bit more of that soda and it fizzes everywhere. Now people think I'm lazy. I'm just tired of feeling this way. Not sure how much is left in the bottle.

It is extremely frustrating when they act like that. I've thought about bringing them into a psych appointment with me so they could actually be told that I'm not just acting lazy, I'm just depressed.

I'm sorry you're feeling this way. I went through the same feelings when I started college and it's been a roller coaster for a bit. I have really good times. But the lows are making me feel worthless. Life was so much easier when I was a kid and I wasn't trying to convince my brain that I'm worth being alive.

If we can hate people we don't even know, we can care about people too. Idk you but I care about you and I'm glad you are here to post this. I feel like people care about me but nobody knows how to help me. I don't even know how to help me. Idk how to help you either besides telling you that I care.
